title: VIX futures September 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the same session as the FOMC decision, four hours before the statement
source: EST: RULE-DERIVED from the venue's own contract specification, re-sourced this session rather than inherited. cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_futures/specifications/ fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 461,261 bytes — byte-identical to the vix-expiration-2027-05-18 lane's 2026-09-05 fetch) states verbatim: 'The final settlement date for a contract with the "VX" ticker symbol is on the Wednesday that is 30 days prior to the third Friday of the calendar month immediately following the month in which the contract expires', and 'If that Wednesday or the Friday that is 30 days following that Wednesday is a Cboe Options holiday, the final settlement date for the contract shall be on the business day immediately preceding that Wednesday.' For the September 2027 contract (VX/U7): the third Friday of October 2027 is 2027-10-15; the Wednesday 30 calendar days prior is 2027-09-15; NEITHER leg is a holiday — nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, fetched this session) lists the whole 2027 NYSE holiday set verbatim as January 1, January 18, February 15, March 26, May 31, June 18, July 5, September 6, November 25 and December 24, none of which is 2027-09-15 or 2027-10-15. So the second clause does not fire and settlement stands on Wednesday 2027-09-15. APPLYING THAT RULE COLD reproduces 9 of 9 currently listed VX settlement dates read from www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 this session (HTTP 200 after a 301, 1,731 bytes): U6 2026-09-16, V6 2026-10-21, X6 2026-11-18, Z6 2026-12-16, F7 2027-01-20, G7 2027-02-17, H7 2027-03-17, J7 2027-04-21 and K7 2027-05-18 — the last of which is the Juneteenth-displaced Tuesday, i.e. the holiday clause is exercised as well as the base rule. WHY ESTIMATE AND NOT CONFIRMED: VX/U7 IS NOT YET LISTED on that surface. The published VX curve stops at K7 (May 2027), so this date is rule-and-arithmetic, not a listing, and the OCC:/Cboe listing prefix this class promotes under is not yet earned. Promote on VX/U7 appearing on a Cboe settlement or expiration-calendar surface. Discovered during the fomc-2027-09-15 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-2027-09-15 initial research (2026-09-06) because that meeting's +/-5-day corridor returned ZERO tracked events and should not have: this calendar's expiration class stops at opex-2027-06-17 and vix-expiration-2027-05-18, so the September 2027 volatility-settlement stack was simply untracked, not absent. THE FACT WORTH CARRYING: this settlement falls ON the FOMC decision day. Cboe's spec ends VX trading for the expiring contract at 09:00 ET and the SOQ prints in the opening auction, so the September VIX contract settles roughly four and a half hours BEFORE the 14:00 ET statement it was written to span — the expiring tenor measures the meeting without ever observing it. MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED, AND IT IS NOT RARE: applying the same rule across all 167 scheduled FOMC meetings 2007-2027 from the Board's own calendars, the decision day IS the VIX monthly settlement date on 45 of them, and 13 of the 21 Septembers. The collision is calendar-forced rather than remarkable — when October's third Friday is 28 days after September's, the September VIX settlement lands on the Wednesday two days before September expiry, which in the current alignment is also the decision Wednesday. A later lane should NOT write this up as an anomaly. NO PLAYBOOK IS KEYED TO IT: trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md carry no opex-, expiration- or vol-settlement-keyed entry (the vix-expiration-2027-05-18 lane grepped this in 2026-09-05 and its own FOMC-in-strip premium test came out the wrong sign, REFUTED). Impact low; it supports one execution guard — nothing reads the 2027-09-15 opening auction as information — and licenses nothing. Estimate widens caution only.
